page.overview:
What is Ankle Monitor?

The Ankle Monitor was an item implemented into Minecraft as a joke for April Fools Day.

Ankle monitors were equipped in the boots slot. In survival mode, when equipped, it could not be taken off. However, players in Creative mode are unaffected.

When equipped, the player would be afflicted with I.

During the night, being a certain number of blocks from the world spawn, above a certain minimum, would prompt the following message in chat: "CURFEW WARNING! You are violating your house arrest! Get back by [distance] meters!"
